decision: One Statements & reminders entry after a single summary; existing histories/profile/Owner controls grouped; statement and reminder are body panes in the existing role host.
alternativesRejected: Four export/channel buttons appended to detail
browserObserved: Customer summary, single feature entry and three disclosures visible
Entry opens Statement body with period/preview/share/reminder
Share opens PDF/Images format choice; Cancel returns
Large reminder body has no horizontal overflow; content scrolls vertically
limitations: Browser mockup is not Android acceptance or an exact reproduction of native chrome geometry
Large text control is a body-layout study; native 200% shared-header/footer/IME behavior still requires implementation checks
Synthetic single-page sample; actual arithmetic/export, long/multi-page output and held states are scoped but not implemented
No real external composer, file export or sending occurs in the prototype
No app code, phone, cloud or financial data changed
hook: Fixed reminder executed, not a validator or independent reviewer
